final: WITH color_totals AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.product_color, 'NO_COLOR') as color, SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) as total_invoiced FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.product_color, 'NO_COLOR')), stats AS (SELECT SUM(total_invoiced) as grand_total, COUNT(*) as num_colors, SUM(total_invoiced) / COUNT(*) as avg_per_color FROM color_totals), above_avg AS (SELECT ct.color, ct.total_invoiced, ct.total_invoiced / s.grand_total as share, (ct.total_invoiced - s.avg_per_color) as above_avg_amount FROM color_totals ct CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE ct.total_invoiced > s.avg_per_color) SELECT AVG(total_invoiced) as avg_invoiced_amount, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(above_avg_amount) as avg_above_average FROM above_avg
